title: a seated board pin lands on its printed contact: pin centre on the contact, press depth in range

origin.what: the seat presses each used castellation onto a conductive PLA bump under bezel ribs 0.3 mm deep (model.js lines 209 and 313 to 319) and only its fits rows claim the contact (lines 575 to 576); the flagship MIDI pad (2026-10-13, finding K-04) could not end a read path at the seat and ran four test leads to the body edge
